svg.aria-label: A range scan on a B+ tree: find orders with ids between 255 and 420. The database descends from the root once to the leaf holding 255, then reads forward along the linked leaves, 255 to 270, 270 to 300, 300 to 420, without going back up the tree, and stops at the first key above 420. Because keys are stored in sorted order, ORDER BY on the index key also comes for free.
